title: Surreal Moonlit Vision
description: A surreal dark fantasy scene featuring a central menacing figure with large bulging white eyes, sharp teeth, and a fur-lined hood, surrounded by flowing black ink-like tendrils. To the left a green reptilian creature with red eyes emerges from a swirling blue orb, while a dark mountain with a Japanese pagoda stands under a glowing red moon on the right, with white flowers and plants in the foreground.
